title: Lab 4B — Fargate right-sizing
topic: Fargate CPU/memory sizing, vCPU-GB-second billing, Fargate Spot vs On-Demand, Compute Savings Plans vs RIs, Compute Optimizer, CloudWatch utilization, ECS RunTask monthly batch cost, ephemeral storage, capacity providers
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-31-fargate-rightsizing-cost.md and gsa-fargate-rightsizing-map.md. Answer without peeking at night-31-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Global Ski Atlas runs the Iceland pipeline monthly via EventBridge → ecs:RunTask on Fargate (2 vCPU, 4 GiB) for about two hours. CloudWatch shows CPUUtilization p95 at 22% and MemoryUtilization p95 at 35% across three runs. What is the best next cost step before changing purchase models?

options.A: Register a new task definition revision with lower CPU and memory aligned to actual use
options.B: Replace Fargate with Aurora Serverless v2 for the batch transform
options.C: Buy EC2 Reserved Instances for the Fargate tasks
options.D: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the output bucket

questions.question: The Iceland batch job can retry next month if interrupted and tolerates a two-minute warning. Which Fargate purchase option best reduces per-run cost?

options.A: Fargate On-Demand — simplest and always cheapest for batch
options.B: EC2 Dedicated Hosts for compliance isolation
options.C: Fargate Spot capacity provider on the RunTask / capacity strategy
options.D: Lambda Provisioned Concurrency for the entire OSM download

questions.question: Finance sees steady Fargate, Lambda, and EC2 spend across multiple teams and wants a flexible 1-year commit that applies across instance families and Regions. Which option fits?

options.C: EC2 Instance Savings Plan locked to m6i.large in us-east-1a only
options.D: RDS Reserved Instance for the ECS cluster

questions.question: How does AWS bill a Fargate task while it is in RUNNING state in us-east-1 Linux x86?

options.A: Per ECS cluster hour regardless of task count
options.B: Per NAT Gateway hour attached to the task ENI
options.C: Per vCPU-second and per GiB-second of configured task CPU and memory

questions.question: A developer registers an ECS Fargate task definition with 2048 CPU units (2 vCPU) and 512 MiB memory. Registration fails. What is the most likely cause?

options.A: Fargate requires awsvpc network mode with assignPublicIp ENABLED
options.B: 512 MiB is below the minimum memory allowed for 2 vCPU on Fargate
options.C: Task role must equal execution role name
options.D: EventBridge cannot target task definitions above 1 vCPU

questions.question: After right-sizing Iceland from 2 vCPU / 4 GiB to 1 vCPU / 2 GiB, a task stops with exit code 137 and stoppedReason mentioning OutOfMemoryError. What should you do?

options.A: Increase memory in the task definition — CPU may be fine but RAM was undersized
options.B: Switch to S3 Glacier Deep Archive for container logs
options.C: Disable the execution role so the task cannot pull ECR images
options.D: Move the task to a public subnet with assignPublicIp ENABLED

questions.question: night-31-lab compares ecs-task-pipeline-sizing.json scenarios. The pmtiles-heavy row uses 4 vCPU / 8 GiB for embarrassingly parallel tile builds. Which compute pattern from Night 27 is usually cheaper at planet scale?

options.B: AWS Batch on Spot compute environment with parallel jobs writing to S3
options.C: Aurora Multi-AZ as the tile renderer
options.D: ElastiCache Redis as durable tile storage

questions.question: Compute Optimizer returns no ECS recommendations for globalskiatlas-backend-k8s-iceland even though tasks ran last month. What is the most plausible explanation?

options.A: Fargate tasks cannot be analyzed until converted to Lambda
options.B: RunTask-only workloads without an ECS service may lack enough enrolled service history for recommendations
options.C: Compute Optimizer only supports EC2 Classic
options.D: S3 lifecycle rules block Compute Optimizer enrollment

questions.question: Night 12 schedules Iceland with cron(0 6 1 * ? *) instead of rate(1 minute). Which cost statement is correct?

options.A: EventBridge per-invocation fees dominate — cron is always more expensive
options.B: Fargate compute during each run dominates — monthly cron runs the expensive task ~once per month
options.C: Fargate is free when started by EventBridge
options.D: NAT Gateway charges stop when using EventBridge schedules

questions.question: Durable GeoParquet output from Iceland must survive task stop. Where should final artifacts live to optimize cost and durability?

options.A: Fargate ephemeral storage only — no S3 PUT charges
options.B: EC2 Instance Store on a Spot worker
options.C: S3 Standard (with Night 30 lifecycle for older prefixes)

questions.question: Your account runs Fargate tasks in private subnets. The monthly bill shows NAT Gateway data processing far exceeds Fargate vCPU charges. What network change best attacks that line item?

options.A: Shrink task CPU from 2 vCPU to 0.25 vCPU
options.B: Add an internet-facing ALB in front of the batch task
options.C: S3 gateway endpoint and ECR interface endpoints so image/pull traffic avoids NAT
options.D: Enable S3 Object Lock on the output bucket

questions.question: Which statement best contrasts Compute Savings Plans with EC2 Reserved Instances for a team using mostly Fargate RunTask?

options.A: RIs automatically apply to Fargate vCPU-seconds without configuration
options.B: Savings Plans require identical instance type and AZ for all compute
options.C: Savings Plans offer flexible compute spend commitment; standard RIs target specific EC2 instance attributes
options.D: Neither reduces Fargate — only S3 lifecycle rules do

questions.question: A task definition sets ephemeralStorage sizeInGiB to 100 for large local scratch during OSM extract. How is extra ephemeral storage beyond the default billed on Fargate?

options.A: Included free up to 1 TiB for all tasks
options.B: Billed per additional GiB-hour of configured ephemeral storage
options.C: Billed only when objects are transitioned to Glacier
options.D: Charged as EBS io2 IOPS independent of task CPU

questions.question: An ops lead wants CloudWatch to justify downsizing Iceland. Which metrics pair best supports a rightsizing decision?

options.B: ECS CPUUtilization and MemoryUtilization percentiles over multiple task runs
options.C: Route 53 HealthCheckStatus and DNS query count
options.D: AWS Budgets forecasted spend only — no runtime metrics needed

questions.question: Night 10 proved Iceland in private subnets with assignPublicIp DISABLED. A teammate suggests enabling a public IP to reduce Fargate cost. What is correct?

options.A: Public IP removes vCPU charges entirely
options.B: Public IP reduces memory requirements by half
options.C: Public IP does not change Fargate CPU/memory billing — it weakens the private-tier design from Night 9
options.D: Public IP is required for Fargate Spot capacity providers
